instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if c["source"] == "geometry" and abs(c["yaw"] - obs["objects"]["red_pen"]["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
